tei:div.tei:p: "$ (409)༄༅// dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i khog dbub snying por dril ba bzhugs so/// /

(410)༄༅// na mo rat+na gu ru bai/ dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i gzhung rdo rje'i tshig brgya dang lnga bcur bsdus pa 'di ji ltar 'chad pa'i tshul la/ rtsis mgo'i yan lag lngas bshad par bya ste/ rten gyi gang zag gang gis mdzad pa dang*/ phyogs gar gtogs pa dang*/ mtshan ci la gsol ba dang*/ dgos ched gang gi don la mdzad pa dang*/ dbu zhabs su don rnam pa dus bstan pa dang lnga las/ dang po rten gyi gang zag ni/ rje 'gro ba'i mgon po 'bri khung gling pa bstan bcos rtsom pa po'i chos rnam pa lnga dang ldan pa des mdzad de/ lha dang bla ma las gnang ba thob pa gnyis su med pa'i don rtogs pa/ gsung rab thams cad la rang dbang thob pa/ sems can rnams la tshad med pa'i snying rje dang ldan pa/ brgyud pa gong ma'i gdams ngag dang ldan pa/ de lnga dang ldan pas bstan bcos rtsom pa'i spobs pa'am nus pa yod pa yin no/// /gnyis pa phyogs gar gtogs na/ sde snod rin po che gsum gar gtogs/// /gsum pa mtshan ci la gsol na/ (411)brjod bya la mtshan du gsol te/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos zhes bya ba'am/ dgongs pa gcig pa zhes bya'o// bzhi pa dgos ched gang gi don du mdzad na/ spyir bla ma'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas pa/ sems can rnams bla na med pa'i bya ba nub thob par bya ba'i ched du mdzad pa dang*/ khyad par du 'jig rten mgon po'i chos mdzod dang zhing rgyas par bya ba'i ched du mdzad do lnga pa dbu zhabs su don dus bstan na/ don rnam pa gsum gyis bstan te/ dang po 'chad pa klad kyi don dang*/ bar du 'chad pa gzhung gi don dang*/ tha mar 'chad pa 'jug gi don dang gsum lo// dang po la gnyis te/ mchod par brjod pa dang*/ 'bri bar dam bca' ba ste/ dang po ni/ dri med 'od gsal sogs dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyal ba mchog gi zhes sogs kyis bstan te tshig gi don ni go sla'o/// /gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gsum ste/

mdor bstan te lus rnam par bzhag pas khog phub pa gdugs spyi lta bu'i (412)tshul du bstan pa dang gcig /bye brag so sor phye nas yan lag rgyas par bshad pa gdugs rtsibs kyi tshul du bstan pa dang gnyis/ don bsdus pa'i chings gnad kyi gdams ngag nyams len 'bras bu dang bcas pa sham bu'i tshul du bstan pa dang gsum mo// dang po la brgyad de/ dbye bsdu lhan thabs kyi 'debs tshul/ yin min grub mtha'i 'gal spong*/ tshoms bdun go rim gyi rnam dbye/ chos lngar thams cad 'dus tshul/ dgongs pa gcig tshul gyi sgra bshad kyi tshig /gzhi lam 'bras bu'i sbyor so// de dag gi spyi'i don bsdus/ chos bdag gang zag gi rnam thar dang brgyad las/ dang po ni/ spyir khyad chos rnams bsdams pas/ rdo rje'i gsung nyis brgya lhag gcig mchis pa las/ gzhung snga ma brgya dang lnga bcur grangs nges pa la gzhung gzhan rnams nas lnga bcu lhag gcig lhan thabs kyi tshul du nang du btab nas bshad dgos pas de la tshoms su byas na rnam grangs bdun yod pa las/ da res chos kyi 'khor lo spyi'i gnad bsdus sngon la smos pa'i skabs yin pas 'dir rdo rje'i gsung brgya lnga bcu/ rtsa ba'i tshig sum cu so bzhi'i khongs su rdo rje'i gsung lnga bcu lhag gcig lhan thabs khongs su bsdus pa la tshig gnyis gnyis dang gsum gsum gcig tu bsdoms pa rnams dmigs bsal ni/ dang po chos kyi 'khor lo spyi'i gnad bsdus la sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad gshis sam babs kyi gnas lugs bstan bya ba 'dir ni/ dam pa'i chos dgongs pa gcig pa 'di'i don mtha' dag phyogs gcig tu rdo rje'i gsung gcig gis bsdoms pa yin pas/ chos 'di'i khog phub lus rnam par gzhag pa yin te/ 'on kyang 'dir dbye gzhi dbye ba'i (413)ya gyal du bgrang ba yin pa dang*/ gnyis pa tshig de nyid kyi yang ngo skal gyi mtshon pa zur du bshad pa zhig yod pas/

tshig de'i khongs su/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyi bstan pa gcig bya ba dang*/ theg pa dang grub mtha' sangs rgyas kyi rten 'brel bya ba'i tshig 'di gnyis mar bsdus nas rtsa tshig gcig tu dbye/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por bzhag bya ba 'di chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong thams cad sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs su gcig /ces pa 'di'i khongs su bsdus pas rtsa tshig gcig go /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis re re bzhin kun ci rigs su tshang bya ba dang*/ sde snod gsum re re bzhin du sde snod gsum gar 'dus bya ba 'di gnyis/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi lam skye ba'i rim pa bya ba 'di'i khongs su mar bsdus pas rtsa tshig gcig /chos kyi 'khor lo gsum 'khor gyi rtog pa'i khyad par bstan pa yin bya ba 'di'i khongs su/ 'khor 'das thams cad phun sum tshogs pa lngas bsdus/ bya ba 'di yar bsdus pas rtsa ba'i tshig gcig /thun mong gi mdo dang sems tsam ston pa'i bka' ni mngon pa'i sde snod bya ba ni/ sems tsam ston pa'i bka' nyid dbu ma bston bya ba 'di'i khongs su mar bsdus pas rtsa ba'i tshig gcig /bon dang mu stegs kyi sgor zhugs pas bden pa mthong ba'i gnas med bya ba 'di dang*/ thar pa'i cha dang mthun pa 'ga' zhig ni yod par mi 'gal ces pa 'di gnyis/ mu stegs pa la yang gshis kyi dge ba'i bsgrub bya mang po yod bya ba 'di'i khongs su mar bsdus pas rtsa tshig gcig /sdom pa bsrung ba dang snying rje phyi rol pa la yang (414)mang po yod bya ba 'di/ phyi nang gi khyad par skyabs su 'gro ba bya ba 'di'i khongs su 'dus/ sngags mtshan nyid kyi khyad par dbang bya ba 'di'i khongs su sngags mtshan nyid gnyis char rgyu lam 'bras bu thams cad du sangs rgyas gcig pu'i lam bgrod bya ba dang rgyu mtshan nyid kyi theg pas kyang tshe gcig gis sangs rgyas bya ba 'di nyid 'du/

sngags mtshan nyid gang la gang med kyang rdzogs pa'i byang chub mi 'thob bya ba 'di'i khongs su chos dang nyams len gyis 'gros kyis sangs rgyas gcig bya ba 'di 'du/ sdom gsum slang bya mi dge ba bcu spong ba'i sdom par gnad gcig bya ba 'di'i khongs su sdom pa gsum gong nas gong du dog tu 'gro bya ba 'di 'du/ khams rang bzhin gyis rnam dag bral 'bras yon tan dang ldan bya ba 'di'i khongs su byin rlabs dang ldan pas kun gzhi dus gzhan du yang mthong bya ba 'di 'du/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun rgyu de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po la yod bya ba 'di'i khongs su/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi sa tshun chad tshogs lam gyi ngo bos bgrod bya ba 'di'i sdu/ nyan rang sangs rgyas kyi rgyu dang ldan pas mthar byang chub chen por 'gyur bya ba 'di'i khongs su log sred can yang thub pa'i dgongs pas mthar byang chub tu 'gyur ba dang mi 'gal bya ba 'di 'dus te/ brgya lnga bcu mar bzhed kyang bkod pa gsum char du spyan snga nyid nas tshig 'di gnyis bsdoms te/ log sred can dang nyan rang yang mthar byang chub tu 'gyur bya ba gcig yod pa 'di dang 'di gnyis bsdoms pas rtsa tshig gcig bya// ༈ //kun la phan pa rten 'brel gyi gnad bsdus la/ rten 'brel sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin bya ba 'di'i khongs su (415)theg pa dang grub mtha' thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rten 'brel bya ba 'di 'du/ 'khor ba la thog mtha' med de spros bral mtha' bral bya ba 'dir 'khor ba ni lus 'khor ba yin bya ba 'di'i lus 'khor ba yin bya ba 'di'i khongs su yar bsdu// ༈ //'dul ba so sor thar pa'i gnad bsdus la/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba theg pa thun mong bya ba 'di'i khongs su lhag par theg pa chen por bzhugs par gsal bya ba dang*/ chos kun so sor thar pa'i sdom gsum re rer 'du bya ba 'di gnyis bsdus pas rtsa tshig gcig

/bcas pa dang rang bzhin gyi kha na ma tho ba gcig bya ba 'di'i khongs su sde pa bzhi char gyi rtsa ba'i lung sde bzhi 'di nyid kho na bya ba 'di 'du/ 'gro drug gang gis bcas pa bsrungs kyang yon tan 'byung bya ba dang*/ 'gro drug gang gis bcas pa las 'das pas nyes dmigs 'byung bya ba 'di gnyis spyan snga nyid kyi gsung las bcas pa'i yon tan dang nyes dmigs gang la yang 'byung bya ba 'di bsdus pas 'dir yang gcig tu 'dus/ spyir bkag pa thams cad ye bkag gnang ba thams cad ye gnang bya ba 'di'i khongs su bsgrubs par ma nus pa las rmi lam du nyams kyang nyes pa 'byung bya ba 'di 'du/ gtong ba'i rgyu de dag gis mi gtong ba yang yod bya ba 'di'i khongs su pham pa bzhi bu lon nor can ltar 'gyur bya ba 'di 'du/ ༈ /bslab pa byang chub sems kyi gnad bsdus la/ ci rigs kyis kyang tshul khrims kyi sgom par 'gyur bya ba 'di'i khongs su dag pa'i sa thob nas ngan song du 'gro ba yod bya ba dang*/ rgyu spyad na sa bcu pa yang ngan 'gror ltung bya ba 'di gnyis bsdu/ rang gzhan brjes pas nyes par 'gyur ba'i skabs yod (416)bya ba 'di'i khongs su/ nyams len rmad du byung ba rnal 'byor nang gi tshogs sog bya ba dang*/ gegs sel khyad 'phags la ma gtogs dmigs pa bya ba 'di gnyis bsdu/ rtogs pa gcig gis sa lam ma lus pa bgrod bya ba 'di'i khongs su/ ting nge 'dzin gyis bsdus tshad rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin du gcig bya ba 'di bsdu/ lam thams cad rim gyis 'jug ste/ mi 'gal bya ba 'di'i khongs su lam gyi bgrod pa thams cad sa bcus bgrod bya ba 'di bsdu// ༈ //gsang sngags rig 'dzin sdom pa'i gnad bsdus la/ sngags ni bstan pa gzhan la yang 'byung bya ba 'di'i khongs su sngags ni sde snod gsum ga'i snying po bya ba 'di bsdu/ dbang gi don rgyud la skyes na thob bya ba 'di yi khongs su/

rgyud la skyes kyang brgyud pa'i chos zab pas cho ga bya dgos bya ba 'di bsdu/ lha phyogs gcig pas kyang dbang bskur du bya ba 'gro 'di'i khongs su/ lha gcig gis kyang phrin las thams cad 'grub bya ba 'di dang*/ lha thams cad kyi mtshan nyid lhag pa'i lhas bzung bya ba 'di gnyis bsdu/ dpe don rtogs pa ma skyes na don khong du mi chud bya ba 'di'i khongs su dus bzhir rtsa ba'i dam tshig gnang ba'i skabs med bya ba 'di bsdu/ bskyed rim ni yongs su grub pa bya ba 'di'i khongs su/ dka' thub la sogs pa ni tha mal gyi lus su brtags pas smad bya ba dang*/ lha rten 'brel gyi tshogs pa las grub par shes dgos bya ba dang*/ lha la gcig car du 'jug pa gnad zab bya ba dang*/ gsum po 'di yar bsdus nas bzhi ga rtsa tshig gcig tu bya/ dbang po rab la cho ga rgyas pa thams cad lhag par dgos shing gal che bya ba 'di'i khongs su/ drang don (417)nges don med par cho ga thams cad rgyas pa dgos bya ba dang*/ gang gis 'dul ba gtso bor gyur pa la bsdu ba yang bzhed bya ba dang*/ srung ba'i 'khor lo rmad du byung ba byang chub kyi go cha bya ba dang gsum po 'di bsdus nas bzhi char rtsa tshig gcig tu bya/ mi zab pa'i gdams ngag med na zab pa rtsa rlung gis sangs mi rgya bya ba 'di'i khongs su/ rtsa rlung gi gnad lhag par 'dul ba che bya ba dang*/ byin rlabs dang ldan pas kun gzhi dus gzhan du yang mthong bya ba 'di gnyis bsdus te rtsa tshig gcig /nyon mongs pa'i bral 'bras bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po bya ba 'di'i khongs su/ snyigs ma dug bcas kyi rtsa rlung thig le khyad par du zab pa bya ba 'di bsdu/ sngags la tshul khrims med pa'i kha thabs med bya ba 'di'i khongs su/ bslab pa gsum gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la yang lam rim bya ba dang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa drug theg pa gsum char gyi lam bya ba 'di gnyis bsdu/

rdo rje slob dpon rgyud tshod mtho na de nyid kyis 'dren bya ba 'di'i khongs su/ dpon slob gnyis ka phan tshun du dam tshig mnyam bya ba 'di bsdu// ༈ /khyad par du lta sgom spyod pa'i gnad bsdus la/ phyag rgya chen po la dge ba'i ngo bos mi sgrib bya ba 'di/ phyag rgya chen po yon tan thams cad kyi bdag nyid bya ba 'di'i khongs su bsdu/ rgyu ma bsgrubs na ni thams cad mi 'byung bya ba 'di'i khongs su bral 'bras thams cad rgyu dang bcas pa bya ba 'di bsdu/ sgom bya sgom byed gnyis med nam mkha' gnyis 'dres ni nyan thos kyi mngon rtogs bya ba 'di stong nyid rgyu 'bras su 'byung bya ba 'di'i khongs su bsdu/ rtogs ldan la thabs lam (418)la sogs pa lhag par gal che bya ba 'di'i khongs su/ rlung mi 'dzin pa lhug par 'jog pa gdams ngag zab bya ba dang*/ mchog gi 'pho ba rnam shes bla ma'i 'od gsal bya ba 'di gnyis bsdu// ༈ //'bras bu sangs rgyas pa'i gnad bsdus la/ sangs rgyas kyis na thugs bskyed yod bya ba 'di'i khongs su/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems kyi rang gzugs yin bya ba 'di bsdu/ de ltar na rtsa ba'i tshig sum cu rtsa bzhi'i khongs su/ rdo rje'i gsung lnga bcu lhan thabs su btab pas/ tshig de dag gis ston pa'i don ma tshang ba med par byas pa zhig 'byung bas/ 'jig rten mgon po'i grub mtha' chen mo thams cad 'di'i khongs su 'dus so// gnyis pa bye brag gi bzhed pa mtha' yas pa la/ phal cher gcig ni rdo rje'i gsung 'di rnams rgyas par bshad pa de'i zhol la sgrog rang brdal du 'gro ba mang bas/ de ltar na chos 'di'i nang du ni 'jig rten mgon po'i chos spyi dang bye brag gi bzhed pa thams cad 'dus pa yin byas kyang mi 'gal te/ zhal snga nas/ e ma mtshungs med dpal ldan 'gro mgon gyi// dam chos zab cing rgya che bla med pa'i// dgongs pa rgya mtsho che ltar yangs pa las// cung zad phyogs su bsdus pa brgyad khri ste// zhes gsungs te/

bye brag tu phye na bzhed pa mtha' yas par 'gro ba yin no// gnyis pa yin min grub mtha'i 'gal spong ni/ de ltar 'dir 'jig rten mgon po'i grub mtha' thams cad 'dus pa yin byas kyang mi 'gal zhes smras tsam na/ 'ga' zhig snyam na nyams len bya rgyu med par re zhig ngag tu tshig tsam gyi smras rgyu'i 'dod lugs kyis/ grub mtha'i rnam bzhag rkyang ba zhig yin nam snyam nas// khyed kyi grub mtha' de zer 'ang bar 'dug ste/ 'on kyang 'di grub mtha' yin pa'i lugs dang ma yin pa'i lugs gnyis yin/ yin pa ltar na ji lta ba'am grub mtha' zhes pa don gcig ste/ tshig tu brjod ma brjod kyi khyad par las med do// slob dpon (419)'phags pa'i zhal nas/ gang tshe nga la khas len med/ de tshe skyon dang bral ba yin/ gsung*/ 'on kyang ma brjod kyang*/ rgyal ba'i sras po cang mi gsung*// mi gsung ba de rgya cher bshad// ces pa'i tshul lta bur 'gro ba dang*/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas dge ba gshis kyi dge ba ste/ dge ba dkar po dge ba'i mtshan nyid 'dzin pa'i dge ba mi dge bar mi 'gyur/ mi dge ba gshis kyi mi dge ba ste/ mi dge ba nag pos mi dge ba'i mtshan nyid 'dzin pa'i mi dge ba dge bar mi 'gyur bya ba 'di nga'i grub mtha' chen mo yin gsung ba dang*/ nga'i bus grub mtha'i brtags pas rjes su 'brang ba'i slob ma rnams chos 'dzin bde ba yin bya ba dang*/ nyams su myong bas 'di la nges shes skyes/ rjes su 'brangs pa grub pa'i mtha' 'di 'dzin bya ba dang*/ 'di ni 'di ltar bzhed do bya ba dang*/ 'di rnams ni grub mtha' chen mor grags pa yin te bya ba la sogs pa rnams kyi ngos nas 'di grub mtha' byas kyang 'gal ba med/ grub mtha' ma yin pa ltar na/ 'di na mkhas pa chen por 'dod pa rnams rang gi rgyud logs su bzhag chos logs shig tu bzhag ste/ rgyud dang chos ma 'dres par so so tha dad byas te// bshad pa'i dus na pha gi na zer nas// chos thag ring zhig tu yod par bsgrubs te// thog tu mi 'bab pa'i rnam bzhag cig gis bshad pa mang po byed de/

rang rgyud kyi steng du sbyar nas chos nyams len du mi bshad par/ rtsis mkhan bzhin du kha phyi rol du bltas nas// phyi rol tu chos thams cad bsngo bgrang byed pa de// dus gsum gyi rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ma yin te// 'jig rten mgon pos grub mtha' blo yi mdud pa la// sangs rgyas dgongs par 'khrul ba rnams// de nyid rtogs par gyur nas kyang*// dran 'dzin rang sar dag mdzod gsol// zhes pa dang*/ lta ba thams cad gzung 'dzin gnyis med nges// gzung dang 'dzin (420)pa gti mug ma rag pa// zhes pa dang*/ phra bdun ma las/ bdag 'dzin ma spangs pa'i bzang po mi btub/ de bas na yod med spros pa thams cad kyi// mtha' dang bral ba'i 'dzin pa yang*// grub mtha'i rtogs pa blo yi yul// blo yis byas kyang stong pa min// ces pa dang*/ grub mtha' 'dzin pa thams cad rang rgyud yin// ces pa dang*/ bden pa ni grub pa'i mtha' ji snyed pa thams cad kyis bsgribs pa yin bya ba la sogs pa rnams kyi ngos nas 'di grub mtha' ma yin te/ snying por gyur pa nyams len gyi chos su gdams pa yin pas so// 'o na da ltar gong du grub mtha' byas kyang 'gal ba med bya bas grub mthar khas blangs pa de dag ji ltar yin zhe na/ 'jig rten mgon po'i dgongs pa ji lta ba de lon nas re zhig ming grub mthar btags pa la 'jigs rgyu med de/ zhal snga nas/ pha drin chen gyi dgongs pa len lags na// rmongs pa'i tshig la 'jigs rgyu med// ces gsungs pa dang 'dra bas/ 'di'i don go zhing khong du chud na grub mtha' yin min gang ltar byas kyang 'gal ba med pa yin no// gsum pa tshoms bdun go rim rnam dbye ni// spyi khyad chos de rnams sngon nas mdzad// go rim rjes su bsgrigs pa yin pas/ go rim ji ltar bshad kyang 'gal ba med mod/ 'on kyang 'dir da lta'i 'chad tshul gyi go rim ltar na/ bdag cag gi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten du byon nas legs par gsungs pa dam pa'i chos rin po che'i 'khor lo bskor/

de ltar bskor ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo de ci 'dra ba zhig yin na tshul 'di lta bu zhig yin no// zhes thog mar chos kyi 'khor lo'i tshoms de bshad/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i don de thams cad bsdus na rten 'brel yin pas/ rtsa shes las/ rten cing 'brel 'byung ma gtogs pa// chos 'ga' yod pa ma yin pas// zhes pa dang*/ bshes spring las/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung 'di (421)rgyal ba yi/ gsung gi mdzod kyi gces pa zab mo ste// zhes pas chos thams cad kyi snying po ste mchog dam par gyur pa rten 'brel yin ces pas kun la phan pa'i rten 'brel gyi tshoms de bshad/ rten 'brel de thams cad kyi don nyams len du dril na sdom pa rin po che gsum yin/ de gsum yang rten dang brten pa'i gnad kyi tshul du mas yar rim gyis 'byung*/ gsum po de tshul ji ltar nyams su len na lta sgom spyod gsum rnam par dag pa'i tshul gyis nyams su len/ nyams su blangs pas 'bras bu ci lta bu zhig thob na/ 'bras bu mthar thug sangs rgyas 'di lta bu zhig thob pa yin ces mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi tshoms de bshad pa yin no// bzhi pa chos lngar 'dus tshul ni/ de ltar rtsa ba'i tshig gnyis brgya tham pa la brten nas ji snyed pa zhig bshad pa de dag gis dam pa'i chos lnga ldan gyi lag len skyon spong ba dang*/ yon tan sgrub pa/ gegs sel/ bogs 'don/ gnad dang bcas pa zhig gis gtsang sang gis 'bras bu mthar thug pa sangs rgyas kyi sar 'don pa'i thabs/ grwa ma chag /zur ma nyams/ lhad ma zhugs/ nor ba dang 'khrul pa med pa/ gru bzhi/ logs brgyad/ rtse mo dpal dang dgur ldan pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la bor rgyu rdul tsam yang med pa bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrub par byed pa'i thabs chen po/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong thams cad sangs rgyas sgrub par byed pa'i thabs su gcig bya ba de'i don bstan pa yin te/

zhal snga nas/ bka' dang bstan bcos thams cad du/ 'di las ma bshad rnal 'byor pa// zhes pas tshoms bdun po 'di thams cad kyis lnga ldan gcig bstan pa yin/ tshul ji ltar bstan na/ bslab pa byang chub sems kyi gnad bsdus des byang chub kyi sems bstan/ gsang sngags rig 'dzin sdom pa'i tshoms des yi dam gyi lha bstan/ khyad par lta spyod sgom pa'i tshoms des bla ma'i rnal 'byor (422)bstan/ chos kyi 'khor lo spyi'i tshoms dang*/ kun la phan pa rten 'brel gyi tshoms des phyag rgya chen po bstan/ 'bras bu mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi sa'i tshoms des bsngo ba bstan/ 'dul ba so sor thar pa'i tshoms des spyi'i de rnams thams cad kyi gnad dang gegs sel dang bogs 'don bstan/ khyad par du byang chub sems dang yi dam gyi lha gnyis kyis gegs sel dang bogs 'don bstan/ de ltar na bka' dang bstan bcos thams cad kyi don tshoms bdun po lnga ldan du dril ba/ 'di'i nang du thub pa'i gsung rab ma lus pa thams cad dang*/ de dag gi dgongs pa 'grel pa'i bstan bcos ma lus pa'i don/ nyams len mngon rtogs kyi rim par bsgrigs pa yin pas/ de rnams thams cad rang gi rgyud thog 'dir dran pas dran par byed shes bzhin gyis shes par byed/ bag yod kyis spong len khrig khrig byas nas nyams len byed pa yin te/ zhal snga nas kyang*/ bzhed pa 'di dag gi phyag rgyas thibs shing 'khrul tshud pa la thub pa'i bka' mtha' dag gi dgongs pa dang mthun par rang nyid kyi rgyud thog tu sbyor shes shing go bar gyur ba de dag ni/ zhes pas pha rol po'i ngag sna gnon pa'i ched ma yin par rang gi rgyud thog tu nyams len byed pa'i chos su song ba zhig dgos pa yin no// lnga pa dgongs pa gcig tshul gyi sgra bshad ni/ 'jig rten mgon po nyid kyis/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad chos 'di'i steng du gsungs mthun/

dbyangs mthun/ dgongs pa mthun pas na dgongs pa gcig pa zhes bya'o// gsungs te spyir chos thams cad phyag rgya chen po skye ba med pa'i don du dgongs pa gcig par gzhol zhing 'bab pa yin te/ yum las/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi chos gang yang rung ba gcig gi de bzhin nyid shes na chos thams cad kyi mdo dang rgyas pa shes par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang*/ bye brag tu gdul bya'i blo la ltos nas gzhi (423)lam 'bras gsum du bzhag kyang*/ don du stong nyid rgyu 'bras su shar ba'i rten 'brel gyi rang gzugs las ma 'das pas rnam dbyer med cing dgongs pa gcig tu 'babs pa'i phyir ro// drug pa gzhi lam 'bras bu'i sbyor se ni/ de ltar thabs mkhas pa kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems des khyad par du byas pa'i sdom pa gsum po la sogs pa dkar po'i phyogs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba ma lus pa dang*/ shes rab zab mo skye med phyag rgya chen po dang dbyer med zung 'jug tu nyams su blangs pas 'bras bu skyon med cing yon tan thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gcig 'byung ste/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa'i 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku 'byung*/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'byung*/ gsang sngags rig 'dzin gyi sdom pa las 'bras bu bde ba chen po'i sku 'byung*/ sdom pa gsum gyis rgyud bsdoms pa'i steng du rnal 'byor bzhi ltar nyams su blangs pas chos kyi sku 'byung*/ sku gcig gar yod sar sku gsum ka yod pas/ sku gsum dbyer med pa 'di ngo bo nyid kyi sku yin te/ ji skad du/ sku gsum dbye ba med pa 'di// ngo bo nyid kyi sku zhes brjod// ces gsungs/ sku rnam pa lnga thob pa de la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub zer te/ phyag rgya chen po ni thams cad la khyab pa de nyid yin/ mchog ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi chos sku mthar phyin pa yin/

dngos grub ni yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa thams cad yin/ yang gzhi dang lam gyi dus su thabs mkhas pa kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyis khyad par du byas nas/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pas 'bras bu gzhan de na phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan gzugs sku 'byung*/ shes rab zab mo don dam byang chub sems kyis khyad par du byas nas/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pas 'bras bu rang don phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan chos sku 'byung ste/ klu sgrub kyis/ dge ba 'di yis skye (424)po kun// ces pas kyang bstan la rang don dam pa ni chos kyi sku/ gzhan don dam pa ni gzugs kyi sku ste/ de gnyis byang chub sems gnyis sam/ tshogs gnyis las 'byung*/ de gnyis kyang tha dad ma yin te/ gzhi lam 'bras bu thams cad du gdod ma nas zung 'jug tu gnas pas 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sar yang zung 'jug tu 'byung ba sogs kyis mtshon te shes par bya'o// bdun pa de dag gi spyi'i don bsdu na/ de ltar rgyal ba thams cad kyi dgongs pa gcig pa/ khyad chos brgya dang lnga bcu zhes bya ba 'di/ chos gzhan thams cad pas khyad par 'phags pa zhig yin no zhes smras tsam na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i bka' khong rang gis mkhyen cing*/ thugs su chud pa'i chos da lta gsung rab kyi tshogs su byung ba de rnams kyi don de bas kyang khyad par du 'phags pa zhig yin nam snyam na/ de ltar ma yin/ 'o na gang yin na/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir byung ba'i grub thob 'ga' zhig gis thugs nyams su myong ba dang*/ paṇ+ḍi 'ga' zhig gis 'dod lugs tha dad pa de rnams thams cad dang bod rgan spyi'i chos lugs 'ga' zhig tha dad pa las khyad par du 'phags zhes zer ba yin/ de ma gtogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad ni gang dang yang mi 'gal bas chos thams cad dgongs pa gcig pa 'di'i steng du gzhol zhing 'babs pa'i nyams len cig ston pa yin te/

zhal snga nas kyang*/ nged yin pa gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa yin/ spyod pa 'dul ba'i tshul khrims spyod/ mthun pa thub pa'i bka' dang mthun/ gang la yang mi smad pas chos la brten pa'i g.yang sa med/ log shes can tshar gcod par byed pa ni ma gtogs so// zhes sogs gsungs pas mtshon no// brgyad pa chos bdag gang zag gi rnam par thar pa la/ chos thugs su chud pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dang*/ de'i bka' sdud pa po rje 'bri gung gling pa gnyis ka sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' yongs su grags shing*/ mngon sum tshad mas grub pa sogs sku che ba'i yon tan mtha' yas pa phyog tsam mtshon pa ni so so'i rnam thar las shes so// gnyis pa bye brag so sor phye ba yan lag rgyas par bshad (425)pa rtsibs kyi tshul du bstan pa la gnad bsdus kyi tshoms bdun te/ chos kyi 'khor lo spyi'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms/ kun la phan pa rten 'brel gyi gnad bsdus kyi tshoms/ 'dul ba so so'i thar pa gnad bsdus kyi tshoms/ bslab pa byang chub sems kyi gnad bsdus kyi tshoms/ gsang sngags rig 'dzin sdom pa'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms/ khyad par lta spyod sgom pa gnad bsdus kyi tshoms/ 'bras bu mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi sa'i gnad bsdus kyi tshoms te bdun yin/ dang po la rtsa ba'i tshig sum cu/ bsnan pa bcu drug ste zhe drug /gnyis pa la rtsa ba'i tshig bco lnga/ bsnan pa gcig ste bcu drug /gsum pa la rtsa ba'i tshig bcu dgu/ bsnan pa bzhi dang nyer gsum/ bzhi pa la rtsa ba'i tshig nyer bzhi/ bsnan pa drug dang sum bcu/ lnga pa la rtsa ba'i tshig nyer brgyad/ bsnan pa bcu bdun dang zhe lnga/ drug pa la rtsa ba'i tshig nyi shu/ bsnan pa lnga dang nyer lnga/ bdun pa la rtsa ba'i tshig bco lnga/ bsnan pa gcig dang bcu drug go// gsum pa bsdus pa'i don chings gnad kyi man ngag nyams len 'bras bu sham bu'i tshul du bstan pa la bzhi ste/

khyad chos thams cad kyi don gong du 'dus pa dang*// don de'i nyams len gyi gnad gang du 'dus dang*/ 'gal 'brel gyi gnad bstan pa dang*/ khyad par yon tan gyi 'byung tshul lo// de la dang po ni/ spyir khyad chos 'di rnams kyi don bsdu na tshig du tsam gyi nang du 'du snyam na/ tshig re re'i nang du 'dus pa 'ga' zhig yod de/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad gshis sam babs kyi gnas lugs bstan/ ces pa dang*/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong thams cad sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs gcig yin ces pa dang*/ theg pa thams cad rigs gcig theg pa gcig yin// ces pa dang*/ sdom gsum spang bya mi dge ba bcu spong ba'i sdom par gnad gcig pa yin// ces pa la sogs yin la/ khyad par du spyir dam pa'i chos mtha' (426)dag phyogs gcig tu rdo rje'i gsung gcig gis bsdams pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis gshis sam babs kyi gnas lugs bstan pa yin bya ba 'di yin te/ de yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa dang*/ phyi rol mu stegs pa ltar phywa dang dbang phyug byed pa po ma yin pa dang*/ khams gsum gyi sems can la mkhyen pa'i ye shes ldan pas thugs brtse ba chen po dang ldan pa dang*/ rjes 'brang gi sras rnams la thar bar 'gro ba'i lam ston par mdzad pas sangs rgyas kyi babs bstan pa dang*/ 'dug lugs bstan pa dang*/ gshis bstan pa zhes bya'o// de yang rgyu'i gshis dang babs/ lam gyi gshis dang babs/ 'bras bu'i gshis dang babs gsum du 'ong ste/ 'di la theg pa rnam pa gsum mam/ sngags mtshan nyid gnyis kyis ma bsdus pa med pas rgyu de bzhin gshegs pa'i dngos po gshis kyi gnas lugs yin te/ de dngos su bstan pa dang ma bsten pa'i bye brag dang*/ lam theg pa tha dad pa yin te/ tha dad pa de dag kyang gshis babs gcag pa dang*/ 'bras bu byang chub tha dad par bstan kyang lam sbyangs pa'i khyad par ma gtogs pa/

chos kyi dbyings la dbyer med pa'i tshul go na der ma 'dus pa med pas khyad chos ma lus pa 'di'i don thams cad der 'dus so// gnyis pa don de'i nyams len gyi gnad sdom gsum gnad gcig par 'dus te/ spang bya mi dge ba bcu spong ba dang bsgrub bya dge ba bcu sgrub par gnad gcig te/ dang po 'khor ba la skyo ba skyes pa'i rten gyi gang zag cig nges par dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song nas/ bslab gzhi pa so sor thar pa'i sdom pa ris bdun nam brgyad gang rung blangs te/ 'gal rkyen med pa dang*/ mthun rkyen tshang ba las skyes pa'i sdom pa de/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i smon 'jug gnyis las/ dang po smon pa ma skyes pa skye ba'i rgyu/ skyes nas des khyad (427)par du byas pa'i bslab bya/ 'jug sdom gyi ngo bo sdom pa gsum tshogs pa'i rten 'brel las sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ de gsang sngags kyi dam tshig tu 'gyur te/ dbang bskur ba sngon du 'gro ba'i dam tshig gi de bzhin gshegs pa rig lnga las rnam par snang mdzad kyi dam tshig gi dus thams cad du bsrungs pa/ ltung ba gnyis pa bde gshegs bka' 'das kyi dam tshig yin te/ dam pa ni sangs rgyas yin la/ de'i zhal nas gsungs pa ni tshig yin te sdom pa gsum po gang la yang ltung ba byung yang*/ bka' 'das 'byung bar bzhed pa yin pas/ de ltar na khyad chos 'di'i nyams len gyi gnad ma lus pa thams cad sdom pa gsum du 'dus so// gsum pa 'gal 'grel gyi gnad thams cad ye bkag ye gnang du 'dus te/ so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la ltung ba byung na tā la'i mgo bcad pa ltar 'dod la/ bkag pa ye nas bkag pa'i gsung dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab par gzhan don du lus ngag gi mi dge ba bdun gnang bar 'dod pa ni nyes par mi 'byung bas/ mi dge ba gnang ba med pa'i gsungs dang*/ sngags kyi dam tshig tu nyon mongs pa ma spangs par sangs rgyas par 'dod pas/

'dul bar bkag pa sngags su yang bkag ces pa la sogs pa rnams ni tshig la lar don la la mi 'du bas tshig tha dad du bstan dgos pa byung ba yin/ de yang ston pa de bzhin gshegs pas rgyu so sor nges pa la 'bras bu so sor nges pa 'byung bar gsungs te/ rgyu sa bon dug lnga las 'bras bu dug dang*/ rgyu sa bon sman lnga las 'bras bu sman 'byung ba'am/ rgyu sa bon nas las 'bras bu nas 'byung*/ rgyu sa bon sran ma las 'bras bu sran ma 'byung ba ltar/ rgyu 'bras kyi rten 'brel ma 'dres par thugs su chud pa 'di la/ gnas dang gnas ma yin pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes zer te/ de yang rgyu sa bon dge ba las 'bras bu bde legs 'byung ba dang*/ rgyu sa bon mi dge ba la (428)'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung ba ni gnas yin la/ rgyu dge ba las 'bras sdug bsngal 'byung ba dang*/ rgyu mi dge ba la 'bras bu bde ba 'byung ba ni gnas ma yin pas/ mi dge ba dge bar 'gyur ba'i gnas med/ dge ba mi dge bar 'gyur ba'i gnas med do// mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'dis ston pa'i bstan pa la phyag rgyas ma thebs pa med pas na/ sde snod gsum/ rgyud sde bzhi/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gtan la phebs pa yin pas de ltar na 'gal 'brel gyi gnad thams cad ye bkag ye gnang du 'dus so// bzhi pa khyad par yon tan gyi 'byung tshul ni/ stong nyid rgyu 'bras su 'byung bar 'dus te/ ston pas bstan pa'i lam thams cad 'jug pa chad pa'i stong nyid skye med du skyes par thams cad blo mthun te/ chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong yang 'jug sgo tha dad pa la ltos pa ma gtogs pa/ phugs su rnam par grol bar gcig par mthun pa dang*/ nyan thos kyi mngon rtogs 'bras bu 'gog bden dang*/ ma rig pa rgyu 'bras 'gag pa'i chos nyid mngon du byas pa/ rang rgyal gyi mngon rtogs lugs zlog rten 'brel dang sa bcu lam lnga bgrod pas spang bya sgrib pa gsum zad de/

shing zad na me zad pa bzhin du/ sems dang sems las byung ba thams cad 'gag pa/ chos sku spros dang bral ba mngon du byas pa mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'bras bu mthar thug pa dang*/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg par lam bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin pas mchog gi dngos grub phyag rgya chen po thob pa yin te/ rje mar pa'i zhal nas/ chos zad sar skyol ba snying po'i don// lta ba'i mthar thug phyag rgya che// zhes pa dang*/ rdzogs chen las kyang*/ 'di yi 'bras bu mthar thug ni// rgyu 'bras med pa'i dus shig yin// ces pas rgyu dang 'bras bu thams cad stong pa nyid du 'jug pa dang*/ 'di la thams cad kyis bskyal bar zhal mthun yang*/ 'jig rten mgon po'i dgongs (429)pa gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i chos stong nyid rgyu 'bras su 'byung ba yin te/ rgyu 'bras kyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i gshis rgyu 'di las 'bras bu 'di 'byung ba/ so thar gyi mdo las/ chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung*// zhes pa'am/ rgyu rkyen gyi rten 'brel de nyid spros pa dang bral ba'i rang bzhin du gnas pas/ zla ba sgron mas zhus pa'i mdo las// gang zhig rkyen las skyes pa de ma skyes// zhes pa la sogs pa gzhi dang lam dang*/ mnyam gzhag dang rjes thob gnyis su 'byung ba'i dus dang*/ mnyam rjes gnyis su med pa'i dus yin te/ chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du gyur pa dang*/ mthar phyin pa'i ye shes gnyis po 'di dbyer med par thugs su chud pa'i dus su yang stong pa nyid spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang las rgyu 'bras kyi sbu ris mi 'dor bar 'byung par 'di la stong nyid rgyu 'bras zer te bzhi po 'di go na rdo rje'i gsung 'di dag mi go ba med pas bzhi po 'di mngon du gyur na dgongs pa 'di dag mngon du ma gyur pa med pa yin no// gsum pa mjug gi don la gsum ste/ dgongs pa 'di dag ji lta ba bzhin du 'khrul tshud par go na/

'jig rten mgon po'i sras kyi thu bo yin par bstan pa dang*/ chos 'di'i dbye bsdu ji ltar mdzad pa'i tshul dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub chen por bsngo ba ste/ de dag ni gzhung du ji ltar bstan pa ltar yin pas go sla'o// de ltar na de rnams kyi sgo nas dam pa'i chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i khog dbub kyi don nye bar bsdus pa cung zad bstan zin te/ rgyas par gzhung dang*/ tshoms bdun so so'i 'grel pa las rtogs par bya ba nyid do/// /sarba dā maṅga laṃ bha ba tu// (430)
